mentions.name: Jade Stage
mentions.description: A YouTube supplement that replaces the platform's recommendation algorithm with a transparent shuffle for video discovery. Users can curate, showcase, and amplify their favorite videos, contributing to a community-built time capsule of videos that gives every video an equal-opportunity stage.
mentions.problem: Video discovery is limited by watch history and opaque recommendation algorithms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on building a youtube supplement, not a replacement, that tries to replace the algorithm with a transparent shuffle.

evidence.value: I am working on building a youtube supplement, not a replacement, that tries to replace the algorithm with a transparent shuffle.
